title: A worker adding a closed-field gate plants a failure in each part of a field that can carry free text (a url's host, path, query and fragment)
goal: The worker rules (bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES) say that an item adding a gate that keeps free text out of a stored field plants one failure per part of the field that can carry text (for a url: host, path, query and fragment), not one per field; a brief of an item whose goal names a closed-field gate prints that rule; a test of brief ID on such an item asserts the line.
